title: Scene page: robots drawn from their CAD parts in the look of the Spark videos
summary: The Scene page now renders in 3D like the native Spark (Isaac) videos: the robot's 1,753 CAD parts in white on a pale floor with a 0.5 m grid, soft light and shadows, posed from each robot's simulated body pose and joint angles, which viewer/scene_view.py now adds to the scene file. The page merges each mesh's vertices on a grid a fraction of the part's size (0.25 to 2 mm), so several robots play and record in real time; the full meshes hold about 22 million triangles per robot. Body paths and ghosts are an option. The Runs page's drawing is unchanged.
next: Record videos of the destination_v29 model on terrain scenes.
reason: A viewer page for videos; training, the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
